The '''Corellian target assist blaster defense turret''' was a variety of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] emplacement that was utilized by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The turrets were used to great effect during the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second Battle of Bothawui]] against the invading [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]].
